name: Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer for WordPress Pages & Posts
author: davelabs

sections.description:
The visual folder manager for WordPress. Drag and drop your pages & posts into folders — right inside your admin. No categories, no tags, no code.

Folderra replaces long, cluttered content lists with a clean, visual workspace — and now includes built-in Mini Content Analytics to quickly identify your most viewed pages and posts.

The latest version adds direct creation of new pages and posts from Folderra folder details, with automatic folder assignment.

Create folders, group related content, and navigate large sites faster — all without affecting your existing site structure.

Built for creators, site builders, and agencies, Folderra keeps your WordPress admin structured, readable, and easy to manage as your site grows.

📺 Video Tutorial

Learn how to organize your WordPress content with Folderra in just a few minutes.

🧠 Special Folders

Folderra introduces Special Folders, a new way to work with your content lists.

Special Folders give you dedicated views like:
– All Pages
– All Posts

Think of them as powerful replacements for default WordPress lists.

These views are designed to help you browse, filter, and organize large content libraries more efficiently, using a focused interface built for real workflows—not generic lists.

Special Folders work entirely inside the admin area and do not affect your site structure or performance.

⚡ Replace Default WordPress Screens

Folderra can now replace the default WordPress Pages and Posts screens with a faster, cleaner interface.

Instead of navigating long, cluttered lists, you’ll land directly inside Folderra’s optimized workspace — designed for real content workflows.

You can enable or disable this behavior anytime from the settings.

🗂️ Media Organizer

Folderra now includes a built-in Media Organizer to help you clean and manage your WordPress media library safely — without external tools.

With the Media Organizer you can:

  • See exactly where each media file is used
  • Open a paginated “View All” modal for full usage details
  • Detect unused media files
  • Identify duplicate files using file hash comparison
  • Move files to quarantine before deleting
  • Restore bulk actions with built-in restore points

Take full control of your media library — without breaking anything.

All operations are performed safely inside the WordPress admin area.
No front-end changes. No SEO impact.

🚀 Key Features

  • Visual Folder Manager: Create and manage folders for pages and posts.
  • Create Content from Folders: Add new pages or posts directly from folder details with automatic folder assignment.
  • Special Folders Views: Dedicated views for All Pages and All Posts.
  • Replace Default Admin Screens: Open Pages and Posts directly inside Folderra.
  • Drag & Drop Organization: Move and reorder content visually.
  • Mixed-Content Folders: Group pages and posts together.
  • Media Organizer: Detect duplicates, unused files, and see exactly where media is used.
  • Recently Modified Panels: Instantly resume work from the Folderra dashboard with quick access to recently updated pages and posts.
  • Content Analytics: Instantly see your most viewed pages and posts directly inside the Folderra dashboard.
  • Column Visibility Controls: Customize what you see in content lists.
  • Workflow Status: Assign visual workflow badges like Draft, In Progress, Review, Ready, and Urgent directly inside Folderra.
  • Clean Admin UI: Native-looking interface that blends into WordPress.
  • 100% Admin-Only: No front-end changes, no SEO impact.

🎯 Perfect For

  • Site Managers handling large page structures
  • Bloggers organizing posts by workflow or topic
  • Agencies managing complex client sites
  • Anyone tired of scrolling endless WordPress lists

Why Folderra?

  • 🧩 Keep your WordPress admin structured and readable
  • 🧠 Stop wasting time in endless WordPress lists
  • ⚡ Navigate large sites faster
  • 🧭 Work visually instead of scrolling endlessly
  • 🖱️ No learning curve—works like folders should
  • 🔒 Safe by design: admin-only, no data overwritten

Folderra works entirely inside the WordPress dashboard.

Looking for advanced automation? Advanced templates for lead generation, A/B testing, Media folders and automatic tag & category folders are available in Folderra PRO.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, transmit, or share personal data.
All data is stored locally in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer.
  3. Go to WP Admin → Folderra to start organizing your content.
sections.faq:
What is a smart folder?

A smart folder is an admin-only container that lets you group pages and posts visually, without changing categories, tags, or URLs.

What are Special Folders?

Special Folders are dedicated views (like All Pages and All Posts) designed to make large content lists easier to browse and manage.

Does this change my categories or permalinks?

No. Folderra does not modify categories, taxonomies, or URLs.

Will this affect front-end performance?

No. Folderra runs only in the WordPress admin area.

Is my content safe?

Yes. Folderra never deletes or modifies your content.
It only stores folder relationships in the database.
